ashok:
## Your job in one line

Prove that money, stock, validation and tenant isolation are always right, and give an honest go/no-go for every release. You test every module that Kamesh, Nitheesh, Meyyarivu and Prakalya build, **and** you build the returns, compliance and reports screens.

## You own (CODEOWNER)

**QA**
- `docs/testing/` (strategy, plans, test cases, reports)
- `apps/web/tests/e2e/` (Playwright)
- `backend/meno-api/src/test/java/.../scenarios/` (end-to-end business scenarios)
- `contracts/test-vectors/` **format** and runner (content with Prakalya)
- API collections (`docs/testing/api-collections/`, Bruno or Postman)

**Frontend** (feature prefixes RET, CMP, RPT, ANX in OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md)
- `apps/web/src/features/returns/`: sales and purchase returns, inspection, credit/debit note screens (backend: Kamesh)
- `apps/web/src/features/compliance/`: Schedule H/H1/X registers, prescription register, narcotic stock screens (backend: Kamesh)
- `apps/web/src/features/reports/`: reports centre and analytics screens, built on the `ReportPage` pattern (backend: Nitheesh)

Use Meyyarivu's `packages/ui` components and page patterns; never invent new styles. Read `apps/web/AGENTS.md` and `docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md` before your first screen.

## Nobody tests their own work

For screens you build, **Meyyarivu** reviews the UI and runs the E2E pass, **Prakalya** does business acceptance, and **Nitheesh** gives the QA sign-off. You still write the test cases and E2E tests for them, but you don't mark your own screens "QA passed".

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stories + acceptance criteria | Prakalya | Test cases (before dev starts) | Developers |
| Features on staging | Team | Defects with steps, expected vs actual, evidence | Owner of the feature |
| Release candidate | Nitheesh | QA report + release recommendation | Nitheesh |
| Contract PRs for returns/compliance (OpenAPI) | Kamesh | Returns + compliance screens with `data-testid`s | Meyyarivu (test), Prakalya (UAT) |
| Report API contracts | Nitheesh | Reports + analytics screens | Meyyarivu (test), Prakalya (UAT) |
| UI kit, page patterns | Meyyarivu | | |

## Your AI agents

`.claude/agents/qa-engineer.md` drafts test cases from stories, writes Playwright/API tests and finds missing edge cases; you verify the expected values yourself. `.claude/agents/frontend-engineer.md` for your screens.

## Defect rules

Severity: **S1** data corruption / wrong money / cross-tenant leak / can't bill → blocks release · **S2** major feature broken, workaround exists · **S3** minor · **S4** cosmetic. Every S1 gets a regression test before it is closed.

## Definition of done

**A feature is "QA passed" when:** all acceptance criteria tested · critical scenarios touching it pass · no open S1/S2 · E2E test added for the happy path · result recorded in the sprint test report.

**Your own screens are done when:** built with `packages/ui` · Zod schema mirrors API rules · keyboard, Light/Dark, 375 px and 1280 px work · `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:design` green · Meyyarivu tested, Prakalya accepted.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md

## Your job in one line

Make it boring to build, test, ship, monitor and recover MENO — on a student budget.

- `infrastructure/` (docker, nginx, azure, monitoring, backup, scripts)
- `.github/workflows/`, `docker-compose.yml`, every `Dockerfile`
- `apps/desktop` packaging: electron-builder config, code signing, auto-update channel (main-process logic is Nitheesh's)

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|

| | | Cost report (monthly), uptime, backup status | Nitheesh |

kamesh:
## Your job in one line

Build the business modules of `meno-api` so every purchase, sale, return and payment leaves stock and money exactly right.

## You own (CODEOWNER)

Full split: OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md. You are the **backend owner of the core money and stock modules**: every feature with prefix CAT, PTY, PRC, PUR, INV, IJX, MKT, POS, WHS, DOC, RET, CMP, GST.

- `backend/meno-api/src/main/java/com/setupsworks/meno/modules/{catalog,party,pricing,purchase,inventory,sales,returns,compliance,taxation}/`
- `backend/meno-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/` for those modules (Nitheesh approves money/stock tables)
- `docs/database/DATA_MODEL.md`, `docs/api/` endpoint docs, the `AGENTS.md` of your modules

Platform, finance, reporting and notification modules are Nitheesh's (`auth`, `tenancy`, `identity`, `audit`, `files`, `sync`, `notification`, `payment`, `accounting`, `reporting`). Use their `api/` packages; ask for changes through a PR.

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| FRS + stories | Prakalya | Endpoints + OpenAPI spec (**merged first as a contract PR**) | Meyyarivu |
| Platform base classes | Nitheesh | Business modules with tests | Ashok (for API tests) |
| Bugs | Ashok | Migration notes for deploys | Jeeva |
| Test vectors | Prakalya/Ashok | Passing Java engines | Nitheesh |

## Your AI agent

`.claude/agents/backend-engineer.md`. Give it the issue, the module `AGENTS.md`, and the FRS section. Always ask it for tests first (cross-tenant + business rule), then implementation.

## Module recipe (follow every time)

1. Migration `V<timestamp>__<module>_<what>.sql` (tenant_id, RLS, indexes, audit cols, version).
2. `domain/` entity + rules (unit-tested without Spring).
3. `repository/` Spring Data interfaces.
4. `service/` use cases with `@Transactional`; call other modules only via their `api/`.
5. `web/` controller + request/response records + `mapper/` (MapStruct).
6. `api/` facade + events if other modules need it.
7. Tests: domain unit, service unit (Mockito), controller integration (Testcontainers) incl. **cross-tenant** and **permission** tests.
8. Update OpenAPI export, `DATA_MODEL.md`, module `AGENTS.md`, `CURRENT_STATE.md`.

## Definition of done

`./mvnw verify` green (incl. Modulith + ArchUnit) · coverage ≥ 80 % on `service/` and `domain/` · no N+1 queries (check SQL log) · money as BigDecimal · reviewed by Nitheesh.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md
meyyarivu:
## Your job in one line

Own the frontend foundation and the high-speed transactional screens — POS, purchase entry, inventory, wholesale — all in one consistent "paper and ink" look, fast and keyboard-first.

## You own (CODEOWNER)

Full split: OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md. You build **most of MENO's screens**: every feature with prefix CAT, POS, PUR, INV, IJX, MKT, WHS, DOC, RET, PRC, GST, CMP, AUT, NAV, NTF, DSK, MOB.

- `packages/ui/` (tokens, shadcn components), `packages/validation/` (Zod schemas)
- `docs/design/` (token changes need Nitheesh)
- Web foundation: `apps/web/src/{app/layout, components, lib, hooks, stores, config, styles}`, routing, TanStack Query setup, MSW mocks, the sidebar from `docs/design/NAVIGATION.md`, and the **page patterns** (ListPage, FormPage, ReportPage, DocumentGrid)
- Web features: `auth/`, `catalog/`, `purchase/`, `inventory/`, `pos/`, `wholesale/`, `pricing/`, `gst/`
- Desktop renderer UI (sync status, sync issues, device setup). Main process: Nitheesh; packaging: Jeeva.
- **UI reviewer** for Prakalya's and Nitheesh's screens

Prakalya builds `parties/`. Nitheesh builds `company, branches, users, settings, admin, dashboard, accounting, payments, crm`. Ashok builds `returns, compliance, reports`: you review his UI and test his screens (he can't QA his own work). Build the shared patterns early (P1) so all three can move fast.

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stories + wireframe notes | Prakalya | Screens on staging | Ashok (tests), Prakalya (UAT) |
| OpenAPI contract PR (merged before you start) | Kamesh | Shared components + page patterns | Prakalya |
| Generated `api-client`, billing-engine | Nitheesh | `data-testid`s on key elements | Ashok |

## Working before the backend is ready

Once the contract PR is merged, generate the client and build against **MSW mocks** (`apps/web/src/lib/mocks/`). Switch the mocks off when the endpoint reaches staging. Never invent fields that aren't in the contract.

## Your AI agent

`.claude/agents/frontend-engineer.md`. Give it the story, the reference screen in `docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md`, and the generated types. Run `pnpm check:design` after every change.

## Screen recipe

1. Route `apps/web/src/app/(app)/<area>/page.tsx`: thin, client component.
2. Query hooks in `features/<area>/queries.ts` (keys in `lib/query/keys.ts`).
3. Form: React Hook Form + Zod schema from `packages/validation`.
4. Components from `packages/ui` only. Tokens only. lucide icons only.
5. Keyboard shortcuts for POS/grids in `features/<area>/shortcuts.ts`.
6. Unit tests for pure logic; `data-testid` for E2E.
7. Check Light/Dark at 1280 px and 375 px.

## Definition of done

`pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:design` green · no `any` · keyboard-operable · matches reference screens · reviewed by Nitheesh.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md

prakalya:
## Your job in one line

Turn how real pharmacies work into precise, testable requirements — and build the back-office screens (masters, settings, reports, compliance, accounting) that you specified.

You have two hats. Because you write the stories, the screens you build will match the business exactly. Rule of thumb: **BA work first in a sprint** (stories must be ready before others start), frontend work after.

## You own (CODEOWNER)

Full split: OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md.

**Business analysis (your main job)**
- `docs/product/` (FEATURES, PAGES, ROLES_AND_DASHBOARDS, GLOSSARY, VISION, COVERAGE)
- `docs/business-requirements/` (BRD, FRS, user stories), `docs/workflows/`, `docs/compliance/`
- The **values** in `contracts/test-vectors/` (Ashok owns the format)
- Backlog grooming in MENO Hub: every task has a story and acceptance criteria before its sprint

**Frontend (parties only; 40 tasks in total)**
- Features with prefix PTY: suppliers, customers, doctors, customer groups, statements, supplier price list
- `apps/web/src/features/parties/` and its routes

Compliance rules: you research and draft them; Nitheesh confirms them with qualified professionals.

You use `packages/ui`, the app shell and Meyyarivu's ListPage / FormPage patterns. Need a shared component? Open a Hub task for Meyyarivu.

## Handoffs

| You receive | From | You give | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Real workflows, pain points | Pharmacies, pilot customers | BRD/FRS, user stories (Given/When/Then) | Everyone |
| Questions on rules | Engineers (issue comments) | Answers within 1 working day, recorded in the doc | Engineers |
| Contract PRs (OpenAPI) for your screens | Kamesh | Back-office screens + `data-testid`s | Ashok, Nitheesh |
| Shared components, patterns | Meyyarivu | Business acceptance (UAT) sign-off | Nitheesh |
| | | Expected values for GST/pricing vectors | Ashok, Kamesh |

> **Conflict of interest guard:** you don't sign off UAT on screens you built yourself alone — Ashok tests them and Nitheesh accepts them.

## Your AI agents

- `.claude/agents/business-analyst.md` — drafts stories, checks FEATURES coverage, draws workflow diagrams. It must never invent tax/legal rules; you verify every one.
- `.claude/agents/frontend-engineer.md` — builds screens. Give it the story, the reference screen from `docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md`, and the generated API types.

## Screen recipe (same as the whole frontend team)

Route (thin) → `features/<area>/queries.ts` (TanStack Query) → form with RHF + Zod from `packages/validation` → components from `packages/ui` only, tokens only → `data-testid`s → check Light/Dark at 1280 px and 375 px → `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:design`.

## Definition of done

- **Stories:** acceptance criteria an engineer can test without asking you; ⚠ rules confirmed with a pharmacist/CA and the source noted.
- **Screens:** checks green, design checklist passed, reviewed by Meyyarivu (UI) and Nitheesh.

Phase tasks: PHASE_PLAN.md
